entities.summary: Jean-Jacques Aeschlimann is a retired Swiss ice hockey player. He played for several teams in the National League A (NLA), including EHC Biel, HC Lugano, HC Fribourg-Gottéron and Lausanne HC. He also played for the Switzerland men's national ice hockey team on several occasions.
